meta.name: scienceworld-conditional-box-placer
meta.description: Moves an object to one of two destination containers based on a numeric threshold check. Trigger after a measurement (e.g., temperature) is taken. Place object in 'green' box if value > threshold, or 'blue' box if value < threshold.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据测量值将物体自动分拣到不同容器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在科学实验中按阈值自动分拣物品
copy.tagline_en: Automatically sort objects into containers based on measurements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically sort items by threshold in science experiments

howto.what: 当你测量一个物体的数值后，Claude 会根据数值与阈值的比较，将物体放入绿色盒子（数值大于阈值）或蓝色盒子（数值小于阈值）。
howto.when: 你在科学场景中要求 Claude 测量某个物体的数值（如温度）之后，它会自动进行条件判断并放置物体。

say.text: 测量未知物质B的温度，如果超过50度就放进绿色盒子。
say.note: Claude 会先测量，再判断并放置。

say.text: 把房间里的这个物体根据测量结果分类到对应盒子。
say.note: 触发测量和条件放置流程。

howto.what_en: After you measure a numeric value of an object, Claude compares it to a threshold and places the object into the green box (if above) or blue box (if below).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to measure a value (e.g., temperature) in a science scenario, then it performs the conditional placement.

say_en.text: Measure the temperature of unknown substance B and put it in the green box if above 50.
say_en.note: Claude measures, then decides and places.

say_en.text: Sort this object into the correct box based on its measurement.
